meta_title: Phnom Penh Night Market Guide | Location, Hours & Travel Tips
meta_description: Explore Phnom Penh Night Market in Cambodia. Find opening hours, location, food, shopping, transportation and travel information.
intro_body: The Phnom Penh Night Market (Khmer: ផ្សាររាត្រី ភ្នំពេញ) is an open-air evening market located on the riverfront along Preah Sisowath Quay, near the junction with Street 106 in central Phnom Penh, Cambodia.
Every evening as the sun sets, vendors set up stalls selling clothing, accessories, handicrafts, and souvenirs, while a large food section offers grilled dishes, noodles, and drinks beside the river.
More than a shopping spot, the market reflects everyday urban life in Cambodia's capital — a relaxed place where residents wind down and visitors get a feel for local culture after dark.

nearby_items.desc: A riverside promenade for evening walks, city views, and open-air dining along the Tonle Sap.

nearby_items.desc: Cambodia's royal compound and nearby temples showcase classic Khmer architecture.

nearby_items.title: Central Phnom Penh
nearby_items.desc: Explore the city center, including markets and streets close to the riverfront.

bestTime_items.title: Around 17:00
bestTime_items.desc: Stalls begin to open and the temperature eases after the afternoon heat.
Best atmosphere with full lighting, more vendors, and lively crowds.

bestTime_items.title: Avoid Midday
bestTime_items.desc: The market is an evening event; visiting at noon means little is open.

faq_items.q: What time does Phnom Penh Night Market open?
faq_items.a: The market generally begins to open around 17:00 each evening.

faq_items.q: Is Phnom Penh Night Market free to enter?
faq_items.a: Yes, entering the market area is usually free; you pay only for what you buy or eat.

faq_items.q: What can visitors buy at the night market?
faq_items.a: Visitors can find souvenirs, clothing, handicrafts, and a range of local goods.

faq_items.q: Is the night market suitable for tourists?
faq_items.a: Yes, it is a relaxed, family-friendly place to experience Phnom Penh's nightlife and market culture.
